about_the_game:
Embark on a surreal journey in Your World, a VR survival game that blends open-world exploration with a dreamlike, low-poly aesthetic. Immerse yourself in a vibrant landscape where every element is crafted to inspire creativity and survival.

Key Features:

  • Gather and Craft: Collect resources from the environment to craft essential tools and structures. Chop trees, mine stones, and forge metal components to build and expand your personal sanctuary.

  • Farming and Cultivation: Plant and nurture a variety of crops, designing and managing your own farm. Protect your plants from pests and ensure a thriving ecosystem.

  • Creative Freedom: With the core theme of "Your World," shape the environment to your vision. Build unique structures, design intricate landscapes, and create a world that reflects your imagination.

  • Immersive VR Experience: Experience survival like never before with VR gameplay that places you at the heart of a stylized, enchanting world. Every action, from crafting to farming, is designed to be intuitive and immersive.

In Your World, the only limit is your creativity. Prepare to build, survive, and thrive in a realm where your imagination shapes the adventure.

short_description: Your World is a VR open-world survival game with building and crafting. Explore a stylized world, gather resources, and create your own unique world. Survive in the wilderness, manage resources, and expand your domain. Can you turn chaos into a thriving world?
